note: Nallino, Part II p. 245 n. 2, after Schiaparelli: Theon and the Escorial codex have the minutes 25′ and 35′ for the correct 22′ and 38′; the table prints 22′ and 38′. 163° 22′ is the mean of the values at 84° and 96° (162° 47′ and 163° 57′), as every value of the column between two multiples of 12° is the mean of its neighbours; the computation gives 163° 22.5′, and 163° 25′ would leave the two steps 38′ and 32′
